## Products

### NesiVar — AI-powered OBD-II car analysis app
- URL (Turkish): https://www.russellcode.com/nesivar
- URL (English): https://www.russellcode.com/en/nesivar
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/nesivar-ai-analysis/id6771038327
- Platform: iOS
- Price: Free download with in-app purchases

NesiVar is an iOS app that helps you make the right decision before buying a
used car. It connects to the vehicle's OBD-II port with a Vgate iCar Pro V2.1
BLE adapter, reads real ECU data (engine, fuel, exhaust and sensor data), and
interprets it with AI to produce a clear report and a confidence score. Instead
of trusting the dealer's or seller's word, you look at the car's own data.

What NesiVar provides:
- Confidence Score — the car's overall condition at a glance.
- Fault codes (DTC) — hidden or recently cleared trouble codes.
- Live engine data — RPM, temperature, fuel system and sensor readings.
- Chronic issues — known faults specific to a make/model/year, with an estimated
  repair cost category.
- Manufacturer-specific data — e.g. DPF soot level, oil life on supported cars.
- Missing-data analysis — non-responding sensors are treated as a signal, not hidden.

Without an adapter, NesiVar has a "pre-evaluation" mode: enter make, model, year
and fuel type to see the known chronic issues for that vehicle before going to
see the car.

Who it is for: people buying a used car who want an independent pre-check,
people who want to verify a dealer's claims with data, and current owners
curious about their car's health.

Requirements: an OBD-II / SAE J1979 compatible vehicle (generally 2004 and
newer), a Vgate iCar Pro V2.1 BLE OBD-II adapter, and a Bluetooth-capable iPhone.

Important: NesiVar does not replace a professional inspection. Its confidence
score and analyses are informational; consult a qualified expert for a final
purchase decision.

Developer: RussellCode (https://www.russellcode.com)
